description: Master instructed Knox to rename reMarkable files with a 'YYYY-MM-DD - ' date prefix, claiming this was the correct naming convention. No such convention exists in the remarkable-upload skill or anywhere in IES. This was fabricated. Correct convention: short descriptive name only, no date prefix.
correction: Do not invent naming conventions. The remarkable-upload SKILL.md states the document name on the tablet is the filename without extension. For call prep files, the name should be the meeting description only — no date prefix.
systemic_fix: Any naming convention used for reMarkable uploads must come from the skill or from explicit user instruction. If no convention is defined, ask — do not fabricate one.
